description: Run bb threads on Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and about 300 other tool-calling models through RouterAI, with one account and billing in rubles. Sign in with one click and the key saves itself; your balance sits in the sidebar and each thread shows what it has spent. A switch can also route bb's built-in Claude Code provider through RouterAI. Needs a routerai.ru account and OpenCode on the host that runs threads; prompts and thread content go to RouterAI and the chosen model's provider, and RouterAI bills your balance.
